name: GL_LEDGER_SEGMENT_VALUES
description: GL_LEDGER_SEGMENT_VALUES contains information about the balancing segment values that are assigned to a ledger.  Each row specifies a balancing segment value, the ledger it is assigned to, and the start and end date of the assignment.  This table stores the flattened information from the GL_LEDGER_NORM_SEGMENT_VALUES table.  Each parent segment values stored in the GL_LEDGER_NORM_SEGMENT_VALUES table will be expanded into detail segment values before it is stored in this table.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier. Foreign key to GL_LEDGERS.

columns.name: SEGMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Segment type of the segment value assigned to a ledger.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Segment value assigned to a ledger.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when this segment value assigment is inactive.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which the segment value assignment is active.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the segment value assignment.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier. Foreign key to XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
